hints.title: Block Delimited Segments
hints.text: A valid placement segment is bounded by either obstacle characters or grid boundaries, with exact length equal to word length.

hints.title: Extract All Contiguous Line Slots
hints.text: Extract contiguous non-hash characters row by row and column by column by splitting along hash characters.

hints.title: Bidirectional Character Matching
hints.text: A segment matches if its length matches word length and each cell is either a space or equal to the corresponding character of word or reversed word.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * N) checking rows and columns of size M by N
complexity.space: O(M + N) to store row and column segment strings
complexity.notes: Linear scan over all grid cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking cells without segment boundaries creates false positives from partial matches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Splitting on block delimiters directly isolates potential slots.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check both horizontal and vertical directions and test word reversal.
